subject: Logistics: late arrivals, key-drop manifest & bell-desk liaison for Dec 15-16 workshop
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: events@grandharbor.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Logistics: late arrivals, key-drop manifest & bell-desk liaison for Dec 15-16 workshop

Hi team,

We are finalizing arrival logistics for the Redwood executive workshop (Dec 15-16). Quick summary and asks: 

- Attendees: ~42 delegates (attached master list: redwood-master-attendees.csv). Several late-night flights — expect staggered arrivals between 11:00pm–2:30am on Dec 15.
- Key-drop: we need a secure process where keys are pre-labeled and a signed manifest is kept by your night manager. Can you confirm whether the night manager can perform a desk-side key handoff and collect a signature (digital or paper)?
- Luggage & storage: a subset (10 people) will request early luggage hold (arriving at 6:00am). We need a delegated bell-desk contact and short-term storage tags.
- Dietary & accessibility: column called NOTES in the attached CSV flags allergies and ADA needs. Please confirm the best way for the kitchen to receive that file.
- Master bill & discounts: Per our earlier conversation, we expect the contracted 10% meeting room discount applied to the master bill plus a waived overnight valet fee for attendees. Please confirm.

Attachments: redwood-master-attendees.csv (CSV, attendee names + arrival windows + dietary flags).

Plan: once we have a confirmed process for key-drop & night contact, Marissa will send a key-drop manifest template and Aditya will own the master bill reconciliation.

Thanks — appreciate quick confirmation on night manager contact and whether a digital signature capture is acceptable.

Sergio Alvarez
Events & Operations Program Manager
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: events@grandharbor.com (Grand Harbor Hotel Events) <events@grandharbor.com>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Logistics: late arrivals, key-drop manifest & bell-desk liaison for Dec 15-16 workshop

Hi Sergio — thanks for the details and the attendee file. Quick answers below and follow-ups.

- Night manager / key-drop: Nate Blake (night manager) will cover the property from 10:00pm–6:00am. We can do a labeled key packet with a printed manifest and a paper signature next to the key release. If you prefer digital capture, Nate can use our iPad and store a photo of the signed manifest in a secure folder for your records.
- Luggage storage: bell service can tag and store early luggage; no charge for up to 24 hours for group attendees. We will provide locker tags and a luggage tag log.
- Dietary / kitchen: please send the NOTES column as a CSV to banquets@grandharbor.com; our Executive Chef will load it into the meal service plan.
- Master bill & fees: we will apply the 10% contracted meeting discount to eligible F&B and meeting room charges. Overnight valet will be waived for conference attendees. We will need a signed addendum for the master bill terms (we can DocuSign).

I've attached the night manager contact (night-manager-contact.vcf) and copied Nate on this thread. 

Attachment: night-manager-contact.vcf (vCard stub).

Regards,
Claire Donovan
Director of Sales & Events
Grand Harbor Hotel

Thanks — we received the manifest and it looks good. Answers below: 

- Pickup tolerance: we will hold keys and luggage until 3:30am if the guest is on the manifest for the night of Dec 15. After 3:30am we will follow standard lost-key escalation unless you instruct otherwise.
- Digital photos: Nate will capture the signed paper manifest photo and store it in a secure folder. We will name photos using the room number + last name for easy tie-back (e.g., 412-Smith.jpg). Please provide Drive access to events@grandharbor.com so we can drop photos nightly.
- Master bill: breakfast buffet is an eligible F&B item for the 10% meeting discount. We will include that on the addendum and send a DocuSign link for signature.
